name: Entertainer (Zhodani)
description: Arts and entertainment are viewed as important for communicating, stabilising and reinforcing social structures across the Consulate.

artist.name: Artist
artist.description: You are a sculptor, holographer or work in some other creative art.

author.name: Author
author.description: You write for a living, whether it is novels, poetry, plays, speeches, news reports or games.

performer.name: Performer
performer.description: You are an actor, athlete, musician or some other type of public performer.

mishaps.1: Injured. Roll on the Injury table.
mishaps.2: Your art becomes the centre of a scandal. Gain one level of Carouse, Diplomat or Persuade. If SOC 10+, you are forced to move to another world. Roll on the Re-education Events table but you may remain in this career.
mishaps.3: You commit a grievous breach of protocol and public opinion turns against you, ruining your career. Roll Persuade 8+. If successful, you may keep the Benefit roll from this term. If failed, roll on the Re-education Events table.
mishaps.4: One of your Contacts or Allies betrays you, ending your career. That Contact or Ally becomes a Rival or Enemy. If you have no Contacts or Allies, gain a Rival or Enemy.
mishaps.5: An investigation, tour, project or expedition goes wrong, stranding you far from home and ending your career. Gain D3 Contacts as you return home.
mishaps.6: You are tormented by or quarrel with another Entertainer. If SOC 10+, you are forced out of the career and gain that Entertainer as a Rival. If SOC 9-, roll on the Re-education Events table.

events.2: Disaster! Roll on the Mishaps table but you are not ejected from this career, even from a Re-education Event.
events.3: You are invited to take part in a controversial event or exhibition. If you refuse, nothing happens. If you accept, roll Art or Persuade 8+. If successful, gain an extra Benefit roll. If you fail, roll on the Mishaps table.
events.4: You become part of the celebrity circle on your world of residence. Gain one level of Carouse, Persuade or Steward.
events.5: One of your works is especially well received and popular, making you a minor celebrity. Gain an extra Benefit roll.
events.6: You gain a patron in the arts and receive DM+2 to the next Advancement roll and an Ally.
events.7: Life Event. Roll on the Zhodani Life Events table.
events.8: You receive advanced training in a specialist field. Roll EDU 8+ to gain one level in any skill already possessed.
events.9: You go on a tour of the sector, visiting several worlds. Gain D3 Contacts.
events.10: You attempt an extremely challenging task in your field. Roll Art or Persuade 8+. If successful, gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll. If failed, suffer DM-2 to your next Advancement roll.
events.11: You have the opportunity to criticise or bring down a questionable council leader. If you refuse and support the leader, gain DM+2 to your next Advancement roll. If you accept, gain an Enemy and roll Art or Persuade 8+. If successful, your next Advancement roll is automatically successful. If you fail, increase a skill you already possess by one level and roll on the Mishaps table.
events.12: You win a prestigious prize for your work. Your next Advancement roll is automatically successful.
